anomalies.description: A man in a brown uniform physically restrains a woman against a wall while another person lies on the floor; visible grappling and force indicate active physical combat.
Multiple men in suits engage in close-quarters physical struggle in a narrow hallway; one man is seen being pushed or struck, papers flying, and others grapple.
A bald man in a suit brandishes a handgun and is engaged in a struggle with others; physical contact, arm grabs, and weapon presence confirm active fighting.

A firearm is discharged: muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frame f11 (5.0–5.5s) and frame f12 (5.5–6.0s) shows papers flying and people recoiling violently, consistent with a gunshot in close quarters.

After the initial shooting, a man in a suit is seen slumped against the wall, hands over head, while others stand over him; he appears subdued and non-resisting, suggesting targeted intimidation or post-assault control.

Chaotic group violence unfolds in a hallway and elevator area: multiple individuals shoving, grappling, falling, and panicking (e.g., person crouching, others shielding heads), indicating collective violent unrest beyond isolated fights.
A bald man in a military uniform fires a handgun at close range in a hallway; muzzle flash and smoke are visible in frames f2, f4, f5, f6.
The same bald uniformed man fires a handgun again in the hallway; clear muzzle flash and smoke visible in frame f8 (8.0s), with gun extended and body posture indicating discharge.
Multiple men in suits engage in physical struggle in the hallway; one is pinned against the wall while others grapple near a mirror (frames f1, f3).

A second shooting event: a uniformed person (likely same individual) fires again; smoke is visible around the torso and arm in f10 (9.0s), consistent with recent discharge; gun not fully visible but context and smoke support firing.; Third visible discharge: uniformed person’s torso shows smoke in f12 (10.0s) and f13 (10.5s); gun held in right hand, consistent with repeated firing in same location.; Final visible shot: uniformed man holds handgun in right hand, smoke still present around torso in f14 (11.0s) and f15 (11.5s); his expression and stance indicate active engagement; muzzle flash not visible but cumulative smoke and posture confirm recent firing.
A large, bright explosion erupts in the hallway, engulfing a figure in fire and debris; visible as intense white/yellow flash and expanding fireball (frames f13–f16).

A sudden, intense flash and expanding fireball erupts from a point in the hallway, engulfing the area and throwing individuals backward; consistent with a high-energy explosion (e.g., grenade or incendiary device).
A man in a suit is physically restrained and choked by multiple others in a confined space (elevator); his face shows distress and he is unable to resist, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.

A physical altercation occurs in a confined space: one man (center-right, dark suit) grabs another man (left, gray hair, light suit) by the collar/throat area while others intervene or observe closely; the struggle involves pushing and restraining, with visible tension and facial expressions of exertion and alarm.

Multiple men in suits are engaged in close physical struggle: one man is gripping another’s collar/neck while others surround and restrain him; visible tension and force indicate active mutual combat.

The man previously being restrained appears subdued and is held against the wall by multiple individuals; his posture and open mouth suggest he is helpless and under coercive control, consistent with abuse during or after a fight.

A new confrontation emerges: a man in a dark suit (left foreground) faces off aggressively with another man (right), who gestures emphatically while being restrained by a third man behind him; physical contact and posturing indicate ongoing conflict.

Multiple individuals are lying motionless on the floor in a smoke-filled hallway, suggesting they have been incapacitated; one person holds a small illuminated device (possibly a phone or detonator), but the context implies they were overpowered or harmed, fitting the definition of abuse toward helpless victims.
